info.description:
REST API of the ZyVPN Telegram Mini App backend. All
/api/* routes require X-Telegram-Init-Data; /api/admin/*
additionally requires admin role in the database.
info.title: ZyVPN API

409.description: trial already used or active sub exists

clear_visibility.description:
ClearVisibility=true forces plan back to public regardless of
VisibleToReferrerID (which would otherwise mean "leave as-is").

server_ids.description:
ServerIDs — UUID серверов, входящих в тариф. nil = не трогаем,
[] = очистить (тариф станет неактивируемым).

servers.description:
Servers — список серверов, на которые провижинится клиент при активации.
Подтягивается через JOIN с plan_servers, в plans не хранится.

visible_to_referrer_id.description:
VisibleToReferrerID restricts plan visibility to users referred by
this user. NULL means public to everyone.

traffic_24h_up.description: Traffic since N hours ago; nil if not enough snapshots in window.

uptime_24h.description:
Monitoring fields populated by ServerService.
Uptime ratios are 0.0–1.0; nil = no data yet.

servers.description: Clients — per-server xui-клиенты этой подписки. JOIN c subscription_clients.

server.description:
Server — JOIN'нутая инфа о сервере (имя/город/флаг/пинг/статус).
Заполняется только в read-методах, иначе nil.

TelegramInitData.description:
Raw Telegram.WebApp.initData query string. HMAC-SHA256
signed by the bot token; freshness window is 1 hour.
TelegramInitData.name: X-Telegram-Init-Data
